## Learning goal

I can use evidence to decide what to keep, change, remove, or test next.

## Compare evidence with the plan

Check the original situation, facts, assumptions, user needs, necessities, and ranked nice-to-haves. Group repeated feedback into patterns instead of obeying every individual comment.

For each important part, choose:

- **Keep:** evidence shows it works.
- **Change:** evidence points to a specific improvement.
- **Remove:** it adds complexity without enough value.
- **Test:** there is not enough evidence yet.

Finish this sentence: **The evidence changes our understanding of ___, so the next cycle will ___.**

[Use the N.I.C.E. Evaluate Worksheet](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1O_j4gcsUT0ELFpgJk3GiyG6B1l5brKPko-6lO8HQPfk/edit).
